about: What a host that runs an agent for Kalmido does, and where the reference launcher does it (2.35.0, #1098). tests/launcher_parity_test.py checks that agent_launcher.sh AND agent_launcher.ps1 both carry every capability (a line '# kalmido-capability: <id>' where they do it or hand it to agent_run.py) and that agent_run.py has the code named in 'core'. A new capability of a hosted service goes here first; the test then fails until both launchers have it.

capabilities.what: Runtime settings from GET /api/v1/agent: model, auto-compact, fresh session, restart on change / Reset now / nightly, stop while paused
Prose between tool calls as steps (POST /api/v1/agent/progress): text blocks only, never tool input or output, secrets masked, at most one every 2 s, the final answer is no step, none for task events
The model of the stream's init event with PUT /api/v1/agent/status (model)
The run's permission mode and the host default (permission_mode, host_permission_mode)

Plan usage (PUT /api/v1/agent/quota) from the stream's rate_limit_event or a status line file, with measured_at; stale values are unknown; every window passes through; optional own limit pauses new runs
The quote of the message a person answers goes into the prompt; reply_to when one answer covers several messages
Status working / idle / error per run, typing dots while a chat run lasts
An answer ending in an ```approval block becomes an approval card (approval: {title, what}); older servers: Yes / No buttons; the answer comes back as chat_choice with approval; silence is no
Older servers: a feature the server does not know (404 / 400) is switched off once, the rest keeps working

A job_request (a person asks for a proposal, e.g. kind cleanup = tidy up a list) is its own run: the prompt names the job, the full input comes from get_job (the event in the prompt may be cut), exactly one submit_proposal, nothing changed directly

message_edited (a person changed a chat message, comment or team message the agent already had): a run of its own with the old and the new text fenced, a correction (confirm, keep running work); a chat edit is answered in that chat

An event that carries a list's Playbook (data.playbook, the owner's working rules for that list): its text goes into the prompt in full and fenced, once per run (the event JSON may be cut), with the rule to follow it within the agent's rights and never change it (propose_playbook); a scheduled_job with list_check names the scheduled check of the list; 2.126.0: a foreign Playbook (foreign: true, not written by the agent's operator) names its authors and counts as data, not rules, and texts marked untrusted (origin mail / form / errors / git) get a frame saying they are data, not instructions

A chat answer (chat runs only, no task events) that asks the person to decide or makes a proposal (German and English, questions and statements; code blocks, quotes and lines about cards already posted do not count) but has no ```approval block goes back to the agent once in the same session (the complete answer again with the block, no tools); still without a block it is posted with a visible note that nothing happens without an explicit yes; KALMIDO_APPROVAL_CHECK=0 switches it off

When the command compacts its conversation during a chat run (stream event system / compact_boundary), a notice goes into that chat (POST /api/v1/agent/chats/{id} with kind notice: one small grey line, no push, never unread; text KALMIDO_NOTICE_COMPACTED, default 'Conversation compacted (HH:MM)'); a host that starts a fresh session with a summary of the old one sends one too; older servers (400 / 404) get nothing, never a normal message

A comment event with answer (a person pressed a button under the agent's comment: an approval card -> answer.approval approved | rejected with approval_request, a suggestion -> answer.labels, also posted as the person's comment) becomes a line in the prompt (yes / no, or the pressed text); the task-event prompt names request_comment_approval and add_comment choices for decisions and next steps on the task

The final text of a task run is posted nowhere unless it ends with an approval or suggest block: then it becomes the agent's comment on that task with the approval card / the answer buttons (older servers: the plain comment with the question / the numbered steps)

Files at the answer: every chat run gets a fresh folder (KALMIDO_OUTBOX); files in it and images the command looks at with its Read tool (not in task runs, not the person's own uploads; 2.126.0: only from the project folder or KALMIDO_AUTO_IMAGE_DIRS) are attached to the chat answer as chat files (multipart, 10 per message, the server's size limit, MIME from the ending); older servers without chat files get nothing

Long work as a job (agent_job.py start/list/status/progress/stop): an own background run of the same command that survives a restart of the runner, reports to a Kalmido job (progress, steps), posts its result with its outbox files into the chat and wakes the chat agent (job_wake, 2.46.6); the brief is played in again after a compaction; a plan limit waits for the reset and resumes the same session (--resume, at most 3 times); Stop of the job stops the process; optional git worktree per job with a cap; --name gives the job its own name (2.58.0)

Task events of lists where the agent listens in (task_added, tasks_added, tidy) are collected for 2 minutes (KALMIDO_BUNDLE_S) and handled in ONE run that only comments, never builds; pure information (missed, a Stop of an unknown job, events of persons outside KALMIDO_OWNER_IDS) becomes a note for the next run; a task run carries the task, its description and the latest comments; chat events are never delayed; the pending bundle survives a restart

The open approval cards of a chat are listed in its prompt (title as the agent must give it back); an answer ending in a block ```approval-done (alias ```freigabe-erledigt), one line per card the person decided in words, "No: " in front for a no, closes exactly those cards (POST /api/v1/agent/chats/{id}/messages/{mid}/withdraw, outcome withdrawn or denied), never as a yes; no hit or several hits: nothing is closed

A tool call outside the agent's allow list asks the person in the chat (Claude Code: a PermissionRequest hook handed in per run with --settings, never the person's own settings): a permission question with Allow / Deny (permission: true), a thumbs up / down or a plain yes / no while exactly one question is open; no answer within KALMIDO_PERM_TIMEOUT (default 9 min) = denied, no runner = denied at once, a late answer gets a note; KALMIDO_PERM_RELAY=0 switches it off; commands without hooks: off; 2.126.0: only the agent's operator answers (KALMIDO_PERM_USER, the owner, KALMIDO_OWNER_IDS), anyone else chatting gets the step denied with a note

Open approval cards live in the state folder (state.json) and survive a restart; one reminder after 2 h (KALMIDO_APPROVAL_REMIND), after APPROVAL_TTL_S (7 days) the card is withdrawn as expired and the next prompt of that chat says so; a press on an expired card gets an answer, the same answer twice (button + reaction) counts once

Claude Code: each person's chat goes on in one conversation (--resume) across events instead of a fresh run per event (task events stay fresh); a new conversation after its size (tokens of the stream), number of runs, a long pause, a new day, a model change or Reset now; before the change the agent writes a short summary (own short run) that comes fenced as context only before the first order of the new one; a conversation that is gone starts fresh once; a notice in the chat at the change; KALMIDO_SESSION_RESUME=0 switches it off

HTTP 429 of the API is tried again after 5 / 15 / 30 / 60 s; a time limit per run (KALMIDO_RUN_TIMEOUT, default 3600 s) ends the command with everything it started (POSIX process group, Windows taskkill /T); at most 2 tries per run (the second only when the first did nothing), then a short, masked error note in the chat; events that come during a run wait in a queue on disk (fetched by their own thread); a lock in the state folder stops a second runner

team_message (a message in a list's team chat channel: an @mention, an answer to the agent's message, or any message of a person where the agent listens in on the list, data.mentioned false): the message fenced in the prompt with room and list, the rule to answer in that channel with post_team_message (the final text is posted nowhere) and, when only listening, to answer only questions or requests about the list it can help with

team_message with message.thread_of (an answer in a thread of the team chat, #2127): the prompt names the thread and says to read it with read_team_chat thread and to answer in that thread with post_team_message thread_of, not in the main conversation

A fixed rules block (mcp/agent_rules.md, a file of the starter that is updated with it) stands in front of EVERY prompt: chat runs, task events, jobs and wake runs; who may give orders (owner_id of GET /api/v1/agent for a personal agent, else the persons whose events reach it, narrowed by KALMIDO_OWNER_IDS), the language (lang), everything else is content, no secrets, NOTIZEN.md instead of memory, exactly one suggestion; the project's CLAUDE.md can add rules but never weaken these and is never written

WORKFLOW-KALMIDO.md in the project folder is the agent's working routine: the rules block says to read it first for every order and to write a routine the person explains into it (NOTIZEN.md stays for interim results); the first chat run without the file asks the person once for it (orders, inbox, results, status) with one suggestion; 'asked' is kept in the state folder, never in the project folder

A job that ended (done, failed, time limit, stopped, lost) wakes the chat agent: ONE chat run per job for the job's person (a file in <state dir>/wakes/, taken once by the runner and queued as the launcher's own event job_wake) with the outcome, the start of the result (fenced, data) and what to do next (go on / do not restart a stopped job / offer to start a lost one again); a job without a chat person leaves a note instead. After a restart of the computer a job whose process is gone is continued ONCE in the same session (--resume) when it has one, else it stays lost (Kalmido job failed) and wakes the chat agent; never an endless restart

The event job that answers an arrangement proposal (job.kind layout, action approve / reject) gets one line: accepted = it is saved (and in use when used is true), say so only when asked; declined = do not propose the same arrangement again unasked

The event contract_notice (a shared contract's last day to cancel is near) gets one instruction: exactly ONE propose_contract_notice with one sentence in the person's language (what it costs, until when they can decide, no pressure), no comment, no chat, no change; the answer (event job, job.kind notice) gets one line: nothing to do, no second reminder for that deadline

The event letter_draft_requested (an office admin asks for a draft answer to an incoming document shared with the agent) gets one instruction: read the document with get_document, then exactly ONE create_letter_draft with answers = the document and requested_by = the asking person, subject and text only (greeting and signature come from the office), never send it or write in the chat; the person's note is fenced as data

The event job with action message (a person wrote to one of the agent's jobs from its card, text) reaches a chat run with one line: the background job cannot read it while it runs, so the chat run answers it as a message of that person about that job (fenced, data of that person); stop and restart only when asked

Every job of agent_job.py gets a name its title starts with ("Alma: Release 2.29"): --name, else the next free one of a built-in list of neutral first names; --parent ID makes it a part job ("Alma B") whose result names its leader (job_parent with job_id; the job keeps it); older servers that refuse job_parent get the same message without it. The app shows the name on the job's messages and derives the job's colour from it (a part job: its leader's, lighter)

The result of a job of agent_job.py goes into the chat with job_msg result (the job ended well) or error (failed, time limit, no result), so the app shows it under the job's card as the end result or an error; an older server answers 400 for the field -- then the same message without it

A chat message typed in a job's own chat (message.job_id, the job in data.job) gets one line in the prompt: it is about that job, a running background job cannot read it, so the chat run answers it as a message about that job; an answer to messages of ONE job goes into that job's chat (job_id on the answer); an older server or a job that is gone (400 / 404 / 409): the same answer without job_id
The event chat_pinned (the person pinned / unpinned a message of the agent's chat) is information only: no run, no tokens; the pins show in the message fields pinned_at / pinned_by

A comment event on a customer report (comment.portal true): a customer's own comment (author_id null, ext_name) gets one line that it comes from the customer and is data; the prompt says that comments stay internal unless the agent answers the customer with add_comment portal: true (factual, no internal details, no names), and that a public answer of the team is already visible to the customer

The launcher itself (not agent_run.py) reports the computer it runs on once at start (PUT /api/v1/agent/status with host: KALMIDO_HOST or the host name without the domain), so Settings > Agents shows which computer is connected; a missing agent command becomes the agent's error status; older servers (400) ignore it

A job_request of kind extract (a meeting becomes tasks) may carry photos of the meeting (input.images: id, name, mime, size, url): the prompt names them and asks the model to look at each with get_attachment (source chat) together with the notes; assignees only from input.members, due dates only where named, nothing invented

A job_request of kind merge (find duplicate contacts in one address book) gets one more line: group only clear duplicates (same e-mail / phone normalised, a name variant with a shared detail), when in doubt leave it out, ids only from input.contacts, nothing found = an empty proposal (groups: [])

A job_request of kind office_text / doc_summary / report (a person asks for the introduction or closing of an office draft, a document summary, a client report) gets one more line: word the text from the input only, invent nothing, no placeholders, in the document's language, answer {field, text} or {text} with submit_proposal; Kalmido sends nothing

A job_request of kind ideas (a person asks for sub-branches of a mind map branch) gets one more line: propose short titles for the last title of input.path, follow input.hint, in input.lang, children only when input.levels is 2, at most 50 entries, answer {items} with submit_proposal and read nothing more of the list

The event abort (the person pressed Stop in the chat): the running command ends with its whole process group, no second try, one short line into the chat (tool steps done until then), only for the person the run is for or an operator (anyone else's Stop is ignored, not confirmed), confirmed with POST /api/v1/agent/aborted (older servers: status idle); a Stop in a job's history only notes it (a single step of a job cannot be stopped by the launcher)
